The overall stopping distance is the distance the vehicle takes to come to a complete stop from the point at which the driver first sees the hazard to the point the vehicle comes to a final stop. In other words it is the result of adding the reaction distance and the braking distance together.

It can thus be seen that the stopping distance of the vehicle will depend on its speed and the condition of the driver, the road surface and the vehicle itself.

question:
Si vende su vehículo, ¿debe comunicarlo a la Jefatura de Tráfico?
If you sell your vehicle, do you have to inform the Spanish Traffic Department (Jefatura de Tráfico)?

help.en:
3 Documentation for the vehicle    
     
3.1 Registration certificate
In any event, a new vehicle registration certificate will be issued if the variation in the data communicated affects those shown on the aforementioned document.
In other cases, the owner, as shown on the document, must notify the Traffic Headquarters, within a period of 10 days, (from the date of any transaction) when the vehicle is sold / ownership transferred and provide them with the name and address of the new owner / buyer (acquirer).
The purchaser, new owner, must obtain, within thirty days of the acquisition of the vehicle, a new registration document.
The vehicle cannot be used until this document has been obtained.
